title: Promega Wizard DNA Extraction Protocol for Drosophila
author: Finley Grover-Thomas

steps.title: Homogenize Drosophila flies
steps.instruction: Homogenize 10 flies in a 1.5ml Eppendorf tube using Nuclei Lysis Solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 flies to a 1.5ml Eppendorf tube and cover with 300 µL Nuclei Lysis Solution.
Crush flies using a micro-tube pestle; use hands and pestle only for initial crushing.
Once flies are partially disintegrated, an electronic homogenizer may be used to increase efficiency, ensuring the solution is not frothed too much.
Once flies are thoroughly homogenized, add another 300 µL of Nuclei Lysis Solution until the solution is opaque and red-brown.

steps.title: Initial Lysis Incubation
steps.instruction: Vortex the homogenized solution and incubate at 65 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest proteins using Proteinase K at 55 °C.

substeps.instruction: Remove samples from heat and lower the heat block temperature to 55 °C.
Allow samples to cool for a few moments, then add 17.5 µL Proteinase K (not included in the Promega Wizard kit).
Vortex samples thoroughly and incubate at 55 °C for 3 hours, vortexing regularly throughout the incubation.
Remove samples from the heat block and allow to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate proteins and separate the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL Protein Precipitation Solution to each sample and vortex for 20 seconds until thoroughly mixed.
Leave samples on ice for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge samples at 13200 rpm for 4 minutes.
Carefully transfer the supernatant to a new labeled micro-centrifuge/Eppendorf tube without disturbing the pellet.
If any tissue or protein precipitate (white mass) remains in the supernatant, repeat the precipitation and centrifugation steps.
Add 600 µL isopropanol (at room temperature) to the clear supernatant.
Gently invert samples to mix; if no white DNA threads are visible after ~5 minutes, continue with the protocol.
Centrifuge samples at 13200 rpm for 1 minute.
Remove the supernatant, taking care not to disturb the DNA pellet.

steps.title: DNA Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL 70% ethanol and gently invert the tube several times.
Centrifuge at 13200 rpm for 1 minute.
Remove and discard the ethanol without disturbing the DNA pellet.

steps.title: DNA Drying and Rehydration
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and rehydrate the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Invert the open tube onto clean absorbent paper and leave for 10-15 minutes.
Towards the end of the drying time, set the heating block to 65 °C.
Add 100 µL DNA Rehydration Solution (Nuclease Free Water) and incubate at 65 °C for 1 hour, mixing by gently tapping and shaking the tubes.
